name: Ambush Squad [Combat, Selfless, Teamwork]
body:
You know that the keys to victory are sudden attacks and even more sudden retreats.

Prerequisite(s): Base attack bonus +1.

Benefit(s): When you’re adjacent to an ally at the beginning of a surprise round, and both you and that ally can act during that surprise round, your allies can take both a standard action and a move action during that surprise round. Special: You may take both a standard & move action if another ally has this feat.

Normal: Characters can take only a standard action or a move action during a surprise round.
